title: Overnight SpO2 Dip Cluster
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apple:health metric=spo2
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(value_pct<92)) as low_spo2_points by person _time
| where low_spo2_points>3
| sort - low_spo2_points
description: Uses Apple Health SpO2 exports telemetry to monitor clusters of oxygen-saturation dips during sleep in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for repeated nighttime desaturation that warrants a closer look, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Apple Health SpO2 exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily count of low SpO2 readings.
grandmaExplanation: It measures clusters of oxygen-saturation dips during sleep so you can spot repeated nighttime desaturation that warrants a closer look before it becomes annoying.
